autocomplete.description: Enable autocomplete (only for provider=gisgraphy and reverse=false).

bbox.description: Bounding box 'minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat'. Requires reverse=false. Only provider=default.

countrycode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country filter. For nominatim, gisgraphy, or opencagedata.

key.description: Your GraphHopper API key. If not provided, it will be automatically injected from the connection.

location_bias_scale.description: Location bias scale between 0.0 and 1.0. Only provider=default.

osm_tag.description: OSM tags to filter/include or exclude, e.g., 'tourism:museum' or '!tourism:museum'. Only provider=default.

point.description: Coordinate 'lat,lon'. Required when reverse=true; for forward geocoding, acts as location bias.

q.description: Text to geocode (forward geocoding). Required when reverse=false; must be omitted if reverse=true.

radius.description: Search radius. Default: km for provider=default when reverse=true; meters for provider=gisgraphy.

reverse.description: Set to true for reverse geocoding. Default false.

zoom.description: Map-like zoom level controlling focus radius. Only provider=default.

curbside.description: Optional parameter. Specifies on which side a point should be relative to the driver when she leaves/arrives at a start/target/via point. Must be 'any', 'left', or 'right'. Specify for either none or all points.

fail_fast.description: Specifies whether or not the matrix calculation should return with an error as soon as possible in case some points cannot be found or some points are not connected. If set to false, the matrix will be calculated for all valid points and contain null values for entries that could not be calculated.

from_curbside.description: Curbside setting for the from_point parameter. Must be 'any', 'left', or 'right'.

from_point.description: The origin points for the routes in 'latitude,longitude' format. Use together with to_point for asymmetric matrices.

from_point_hint.description: For the from_point parameter. Specifies a hint to prefer a certain street for the closest location lookup.

out_array.description: Specifies which arrays should be included in the response. Specify one or more of 'weights', 'times', 'distances'. The units of distances are meters, times are seconds, and weights are arbitrary.

point.description: Specify multiple points in 'latitude,longitude' format for which the matrix should be calculated. The starts are identical to the destinations. If there are N points, then NxN entries will be calculated. Specify at least three points. Cannot be used together with from_point or to_point.

point_hint.description: Optional parameter. Specifies a hint for each point parameter to prefer a certain street for the closest location lookup.

profile.description: The routing profile. It determines the network, speed and other physical attributes used when computing the route. Valid values include 'car', 'bike', 'foot', 'hike', 'mtb', 'racingbike', 'scooter', 'truck', and 'small_truck'.

snap_prevention.description: Optional parameter to prevent snapping to specific types of roads. Supported values: 'motorway', 'trunk', 'ferry', 'tunnel', 'bridge', 'ford'.

to_curbside.description: Curbside setting for the to_point parameter. Must be 'any', 'left', or 'right'.

to_point.description: The destination points for the routes in 'latitude,longitude' format. Use together with from_point for asymmetric matrices.

to_point_hint.description: For the to_point parameter. Specifies a hint to prefer a certain street for the closest location lookup.

algorithm.description: Special routing algorithm. 'round_trip': returns to start with randomness. 'alternative_route': provides multiple route options.

alternative_route.max_paths.description: Maximum number of alternative paths. Requires algorithm='alternative_route'.

alternative_route.max_share_factor.description: Maximum similarity factor between alternative and optimal route. Requires algorithm='alternative_route'.

alternative_route.max_weight_factor.description: Maximum factor by which alternatives can be longer than optimal route. Requires algorithm='alternative_route'.

calc_points.description: Whether to calculate route geometry points.

ch.disable.description: Enable flexible mode to use custom_model or advanced options below. Set to true for heading, algorithm, etc.

curbside.description: Side of the road for leaving/arriving at each point. Specify for all points or none. Only for motor vehicles.

details.description: Path detail types to include. Available: 'street_name', 'street_ref', 'street_destination', 'leg_time', 'leg_distance', 'roundabout', 'country', 'time', 'distance', 'max_speed', 'max_weight', 'max_width', 'toll', 'road_class', 'road_class_link', 'road_access', 'road_environment', 'hazmat', 'hazmat_tunnel', 'hazmat_water', 'lanes', 'surface', 'smoothness', 'hike_rating', 'mtb_rating', 'foot_network', 'bike_network'

elevation.description: Include altitude as third coordinate in response. Changes format of points and snapped_waypoints fields.

heading.description: Preferred heading direction for each point in degrees (0-360, north-based clockwise). Specify one for start or one per point. Requires ch.disable=true.

heading_penalty.description: Time penalty in seconds for not obeying specified heading. Requires ch.disable=true.

instructions.description: Whether to calculate and return turn-by-turn instructions.

optimize.description: If 'true', reorders points to minimize total travel time. Applies route optimization limits and increases the price.

pass_through.description: Avoid u-turns at via-points with regard to heading_penalty. Requires ch.disable=true.

point.description: Route waypoints as 'latitude,longitude' strings. Specify at least origin and destination. Via points are possible. Example: ['51.131,12.414', '48.224,3.867']

point_hint.description: Optional road name hints for snapping each point. Specify none or the same number as points.

points_encoded.description: Use polyline encoding for geometry (true) or simple coordinate pairs (false).

profile.description: The routing profile determining network, speed, and physical attributes. Common values: 'car', 'bike', 'foot', 'motorcycle', 'mtb', 'racingbike', 'hike'. Default: 'car'

round_trip.distance.description: Approximate round trip length in meters. Requires algorithm='round_trip'.

round_trip.seed.description: Random seed for deterministic round trip results. Requires algorithm='round_trip'.

snap_prevention.description: Prevent snapping to specific road types. Values: 'motorway', 'trunk', 'ferry', 'tunnel', 'bridge', 'ford'

buckets.description: Number of isochrone rings/buckets to return. Divides time_limit/distance_limit into intervals to create nested isochrones. Default is 1.

distance_limit.description: Maximum travel distance in meters from the start point. Either time_limit or distance_limit must be provided.

point.description: Start location as 'latitude,longitude', e.g., '52.529407,13.397634'. Must be a valid coordinate string.

profile.description: Routing profile supported by the target Directions API, for example 'car', 'bike', or 'foot'. Public transit requires separate GTFS/departure-time inputs that this action does not expose. Required.

reverse_flow.description: Direction of reachability calculation. False (default): areas reachable FROM the point. True: areas FROM which the point can be reached.

time_limit.description: Maximum travel time in seconds from the start point. Either time_limit or distance_limit must be provided. Default is 600 seconds if neither is specified by the API.

fail_fast.description: If false, return null for unreachable entries and include hints.

from_point_hints.description: Hint per origin for snapping preference.

from_points.description: Origin coordinates as [longitude, latitude]. Provide with to_points.

point_hints.description: Hint per point for snapping preference (symmetrical).

points.description: Coordinates for symmetric matrix as [longitude, latitude].

snap_preventions.description: Feature types to avoid for snapping (e.g. 'toll', 'ferry').

to_point_hints.description: Hint per destination for snapping preference.

to_points.description: Destination coordinates as [longitude, latitude]. Provide with from_points.
